subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should `GET /sessions/:sessionKey/history` keep emitting numeric `nextCursor` values for existing clients, or may it replace that response contract with opaque generation-aware tokens under an explicit versioned migration?
rationale: The PR improves bounded reads, but the required response-token compatibility policy is not settled by accepting legacy numeric input alone; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Use an additive cursor transition
options.body: Preserve the existing numeric response token and introduce the opaque generation-aware token through a negotiated or versioned field with compatibility coverage.

options.title: Approve the response-contract replacement
options.body: Accept opaque `nextCursor` values as the new contract only with explicit gateway-owner approval and documented upgrade behavior for API consumers.

recommendation.title: Use an additive cursor transition
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing numeric response token and introduce the opaque generation-aware token through a negotiated or versioned field with compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the generation-aware cursor foundation and this HTTP/SSE adopter, so they are best placed to present the compatibility options to the gateway owner.
